name.description: Display name of the LLM provider, e.g. Anthropic.

apiKey.description: Where llmco reads the provider's API key, never the key itself. Absent for servers without authentication, such as a local Ollama.

env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key, without $, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
env.patternErrorMessage: must be an environment variable's name, without $: letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit

anyOf.description: Read the API key from an environment variable.

file.description: Path of the file holding the API key: absolute, starting with ~, or relative to the project's root.

anyOf.description: Read the API key from a file.

title: llmco LLM provider
description: Configuration of an LLM provider, in .llmco/llm-providers/<provider-id>/config.json. Its models live next to it, in models/<model-id>/config.json.
